PARENT_OF.meaning: the gap's parent_result field names the parent

GAP_ON.meaning: the gap's claim_id field names the claim

DEPENDS_ON.meaning: child object id -> parent id, from REGISTER_DELTA_V1 claim_dependencies

DESCENDANT.meaning: resolving the source can change whether the target holds; derived by R1/R2/R3 only

INTRODUCES.meaning: the source gap's repair introduced the assumption

descendant_rules.R1_ID_PRECEDENCE: GAP-DUPID record -> GAP-FIN2UNIV record with the same claim_id
descendant_rules.R2_DEPENDENCY_PROPAGATION: g -> h when h.claim_id is the object id of a register key in g's GAP_GRAPH_V2 descendants (strict transitive dependents of g.claim_id), h != g
descendant_rules.R3_REPAIR_SUCCESSOR: closed gap g -> extracted AD-loop gap h when h.source_rule selects g

source_rules.B1_CROSS_PACKAGE: closed under B1 and its declarations lie in >= 2 distinct research/<package>/ directories

unresolved_rule: a gap is unresolved iff its closure_state is not one of the four grades

B1_VERBATIM_REDECLARATION.text: byte-identical statement text at distinct declaration sites denotes one semantic object

B2_CANONICAL_REDECLARATION.text: statements equal after whitespace collapse and lower-casing denote one semantic object

B3_POINTER_TO_SAME_CONTENT.text: a declaration whose statement names another declaration's file basename points to that declaration's content
